narrative.intro: Total federal contract obligations total $191B for FY2026 to date. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction grew 167.0% year over year. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction grew 125.3% year over year. Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services grew 112.2% year over year. Automobile Manufacturing grew 93.0% year over year. Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology) grew 68.2% year over year. Bare Printed Circuit Board Manufacturing grew 48.5% year over year. Software Publishers grew 45.0% year over year. Other Technical and Trade Schools grew 40.0% year over year. Telecommunications Resellers grew 35.1% year over year. Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction grew 33.3% year over year. The ranking lists the ten industry markets with the largest year-over-year increases in contract obligations for the same fiscal period. The figures reflect partial current-year totals and compare those totals to the same period in the prior year.

sections.heading: Which industries drove the fastest growth in FY2026 to date?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction led growth at 167.0%. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction and Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services followed at 125.3% and 112.2% respectively. Automobile Manufacturing and Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology) also posted double-digit gains at 93.0% and 68.2%.

sections.heading: What scope and limits apply to these growth figures?
sections.body: The ranking covers federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date and compares the same period year over year. The current-year totals are partial, and the list shows the ten markets with the largest year-over-year percentage increases in obligations. The figures are percentage changes in obligations, not dollar-level breakdowns by market.

faq.q: What are the fastest-growing federal contract markets?
faq.a: The fastest-growing federal contract markets are Commercial and Institutional Building Construction (167.0%), Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction (125.3%), and Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services (112.2%). The ranking lists the top ten markets by year-over-year percentage change in contract obligations for FY2026 to date, including Automobile Manufacturing (93.0%) and Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology) (68.2%).

faq.q: How is market growth measured here?
faq.a: Market growth is measured as year-over-year percentage change in federal contract obligations for the same fiscal period. The comparison uses FY2026 to date totals versus the same period in the prior year, and current-year totals are partial.
